# #963 finish #958 (verifier checks for lineage_map, coverage matrix, baseline addendum)

## Found already done on `task/958`
All three checks and their mutations were already in the tree. This session made no edits, because nothing was missing.
- `verify_method.py` sha256 is `67b934d6...a150e3`, so it differs from the pre-#958 `5066235c...`.
- `check_lineage_map` (`verify_method.py:726`) reads method.json key `lineage_map`. It checks source path and hash, status, partition, group, artifact id, path and sha256 against `benchmark/lineage.json`, and that candidate variants are `candidate-unadjudicated`. It also rejects `restricted_claim` and gap rows marked covered.
- `check_matrix` (`verify_method.py:799`) reads `coverage.matrix` (`rows`, `counts`), together with `tasks`, `coverage.uncovered_families` and `common.limitation_codes`. It recounts the rows, requires native `gap` and executed `False`, and rejects any gap row credited as covered.
- `check_addendum` (`verify_method.py:834`) reuses the pinned `build_addendum.py` `check()` by exec with reads routed through `read_repository`. No second builder exists. It compares `baseline-addendum.json` with the recomputed build from method.json and the originals.
- The positive controls are wired at `verify_method.py:853-855` (`lineage-map`, `coverage-matrix`, `baseline-addendum`).
- `baseline-addendum.json` is in `inputs_sha256` (b46e7fb6...).
- README (`benchmark/writing/README.md:44`) says "Sixty-four ... the verifier's `rejected_count`" (35 + 9 + 3 + 17).
- `current-pins.json` has no drift: `preparation.json`, README, addendum, `build_addendum.py`, controls, input-pins, method.json and `verify_method.py` all match.

## Added this session
Nothing. I only checked.

## Results
- `python3 -I -B benchmark/writing/verify_method.py` exits 0. Its last output line is the JSON ending `"rejected_count": 64, "status": "design-consistent"}`.
- The top-level `rejected_count` is 64, up from 47. That is 17 new mutations, and the project-text section's own count is 30.
- The new mutations (`verify_method.py:875-908`):
  - lineage, 7: `lineage-map-source-hash-drift`, `-restricted-claim`, `-original-hash-drift`, `-wrong-artifact-id`, `-wrong-path`, `-candidate-dropped`, `-gap-credited`.
  - matrix, 7: `matrix-task-row-missing`, `-family-row-dropped`, `-limitation-row-dropped`, `-gap-row-credited`, `-gap-task-credited`, `-count-drift`, `-executed-row`.
  - addendum, 3: `addendum-request-hash-drift`, `addendum-method-drift`, `addendum-original-drift`.
- `python3 -I -B benchmark/writing/build_addendum.py --check` exits 0 with status `addendum-consistent`.
- Pin maps checked:
  - `current-pins.json` (sections `current` and `frozen`): all entries match disk on size and sha256.
  - `input-pins.json` `protected_inputs_sha256`: all 62 entries match disk.
  - `current-pins.json` cannot pin itself. The verifier prints its hash (63cfe6da...) under `inputs_sha256`.
- Unchanged, hashed now:
  - `benchmark/protocol.md` is `1aeb83227dc11761160ff80d24eb03a216a2531d90c1a6d10ccb25bb85c7eb2f`, matching both pin maps.
  - The frozen historical files listed in `current-pins.json` match their pins.
- No `__pycache__` exists under `benchmark/`.

## Limits
- The verifier checks design consistency only: `benchmark_ready` is false, no native execution, and independent review is pending.
- I did not run the historical checkers, as instructed.
- I only inspected whole-file output for the README count sentence. Its tail (after "seventeen coverage-record controls") was cut off in the Grep output, so I did not read it.

## What next
The next review of #954 finding 1 can run against this tree. UF-G (`verification.json`) is still pending and was not touched.
